# AR-070 · Triage an Access Request queue

**Before you start:** C09. Use the requests already generated by the course; M10/M11 results add further cases when available.

## Classify before acting

1. Open **Admin > Dashboard > Approval Management**. Inspect Pending and Concluded requests and sort by age.
2. Select at least five course requests with different outcomes. Record ID, recipient, item, stage, age, assigned owner and most recent event.
3. Classify each as waiting for review, scheduled access, provisioning failure, reconciliation question or terminal outcome. Use a saved fixture/timed case if a category is not currently present; label it historical or simulated.
4. For a pending review, inspect the assignee and reminder/escalation settings. For a provisioning failure, inspect the operation error. For future access, compare the effective date.
5. Assign a justified next action and responsible person. Put a failed removal of sensitive test access ahead of a routine catalog question when the evidence warrants it.
6. Perform only the action supported by that state. Re-read the request afterward and record what changed.

**Check:** Every queue item has a concrete next action or evidence that no action is required. Age alone is not the root cause.

**Reset:** Resolve temporary requests you introduced; retain intentionally timed observations with a next check date.

[Approval administration](https://documentation.sailpoint.com/saas/help/requests/approvals_admin.html)
